about: Relationship Lens - unusual account relationships inside each case, measured against the bank baseline

signals.name: HIDDEN_CONTROL
signals.headline: 6 accounts, only 3 real people behind them
signals.sentence: The 6 accounts belong to only 3 people once identity records are resolved; 3 of them control 6 accounts between them (100.0% of the people here, against 31.1% bank-wide). To a bank looking account by account, these look like strangers.

signals.name: FIRST_CONTACT
signals.headline: 6 of 6 transfers were first-ever contact
signals.sentence: Of the 6 transfers, 6 (100.0%) were the first time that sender had ever paid that receiver, against 37.1% of all transfers in the bank. The money moved between people with no history together.

signals.name: BANK_BLIND_SPOT
signals.headline: Bank A cannot see 1 hop(s), Bank B cannot see 1
signals.sentence: Bank A alone sees 5 of the 6 transfers and Bank B alone sees 5. Neither bank on its own can see the whole network; it only becomes visible in the consortium view, which shares salted hashes, never customer data.

signals.name: FRESH_ACCOUNTS
signals.headline: 2 of 6 accounts are under 30 days old
signals.sentence: In this network, 2 of the 6 accounts in this network were opened less than 30 days ago (33.3%), against 1.7% across the whole bank.
